title: OpenAI Formatting & Conversion
summary: This module handles the conversion between DSPy's internal LMRequest/LMResponse objects and various OpenAI API formats. It serializes DSPy requests for OpenAI and deserializes OpenAI responses back into DSPy's standardized structures, including cost extraction.
